# Product captures

`workspace.jpg` and `code-review.jpg` were captured from the real desktop renderer on November 8, 2026, using sample content in the browser preview. No live provider calls or private project data were used. Images are unedited viewport captures.

Run `npm --workspace @umbratic/desktop run dev:web` and open `/preview.html?theme=dark&showcase=1`. For the review image, open Review, choose `review-panel.tsx`, and expand the review.
